guard: self-update reports the selected manager before the global install and hands the selected target to the replacement child
why: The newer-version --self path used to install globally without reportRunningManager, then launch the replacement as [entry, update] with no --space/--server/--creds. Both holes let an operator-named legacy manager go unchecked.

The first mutation puts the report after the install. The named cell observes report-before-install order. The second drops the target flags from the child argv. The named cell observes the selected-target handoff.

mutations.name: report the running manager only after the global install
mutations.expectRed: self-update reports the running manager before the global install
mutations.cell: self-update reports the running manager before the global install
mutations.note: Deleting the pre-install report restores the hole: upgradeAndReconcile never calls reportRunningManager, so the order cell sees report missing (or, with a relocated call after install, report after installEvent).

mutations.name: drop the selected target flags from the replacement child
mutations.find: const child = await rt.spawnGlobal(root, "reconcile", rt.nodePath, [entry, "update", ...targetArgv(target)], env, true);
mutations.replace: const child = await rt.spawnGlobal(root, "reconcile", rt.nodePath, [entry, "update"], env, true);
mutations.expectRed: self-update replacement child carries the selected target flags
mutations.cell: self-update replacement child carries the selected target flags
